blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Education (DepEd) has expanded its Kaagapay Program nationwide to equip more parents, guardians, and caregivers with practical tools to act as co-educators — preventing bullying, fostering positive discipline, and reinforcing values among students. President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. stressed the program’s significance when he and Education Secretary Sonny Angara met with participating parents during a recent Kaagapay session at Patul Elementary School in Santiago City, Isabela. According to a DepEd statement on Monday, the program was established in January this year, guided by DepEd Memorandum No. 002, s. 2026, and harmonized with the Parent Effectiveness […]...
